headline: Carlos Tevez farewell match could bring Messi and Ronaldo together
summary: The football legends are expected to be among 60 stars invited to the former Argentina star's official farewell game in December.
details: Carlos Tevez, who retired from professional football in June 2022, is planning his official farewell match for December at La Bombonera, the home of Boca Juniors.
According to TyC Sports, the event could bring Lionel Messi and Cristiano Ronaldo together on the same pitch, as both are expected to be among the invited guests.
Tevez has already received the green light from Boca president Juan Roman Riquelme to stage the match, which may take place during the second or third week of December.
The match will feature childhood friends and former teammates of Tevez, with around 60 current and former stars expected to attend.
Tevez shared a dressing room with Ronaldo at Manchester United and played for the Argentina national team alongside Messi.
The last time Messi and Ronaldo shared a pitch was in January 2023 during an exhibition friendly between Paris Saint-Germain and Riyadh All-Star XI.
During his career, Tevez made 279 appearances and scored 94 goals for Boca Juniors, winning 11 trophies at the club.
He also played for major European clubs including West Ham United, Manchester United, Manchester City, and Juventus, and earned 76 caps for Argentina.

headline_marked: Cinema and Cricket: [[Taskin Ahmed and Shabnur meet]] at Sydney BBQ
headline: Cinema and Cricket: Taskin Ahmed and Shabnur meet at Sydney BBQ
summary: National pacer Taskin Ahmed and legendary actress Shabnur shared a cozy family gathering in Australia, sparking fan excitement over their unexpected pairing.
details: National cricket team pacer Taskin Ahmed and cinema icon Shabnur recently met during a private family gathering in Sydney, Australia.
The meeting took place at the home of Shabnur's brother, where Taskin, along with his wife and child, attended a home-cooked barbecue party.
Shabnur revealed that the two families have shared a long-standing relationship and have been acquainted for many years.
The celebratory atmosphere lasted until 4 AM, with both families spending quality time together and their children playing.
Both stars shared photos of the gathering on their respective Facebook pages, with Taskin thanking Shabnur and her family for their warm hospitality.
Shabnur expressed her pride in how Bangladeshi cricketers like Taskin are making the country proud on international soil.
Fans reacted with enthusiasm to the photos, with many praising the 'two superstars' from different worlds coming together in one frame.
The photos also reignited requests from Shabnur's fans, who noticed her fit and happy appearance and urged her to return to the silver screen.
